Standalone verifier checked exact Euclidean gcd moments against different ideal-Möbius identities for cutoffs 8,15,24,40 and n=2..5; finite checks are corroborative.

value.rationale: A 2015 concrete and numerically tested conjecture on the Gaussian-integer gcd norm moments is disproved uniformly for every exponent in its domain and replaced by a natural exact convergent constant. The norm-four deficiency explains the structural failure of importing the integer gcd constant, while the corrected series can be computed and aligns with the motivating paper’s fitted values. This is a substantive general mathematical resolution rather than an arbitrary finite fact.
